title: Bear Tug
hook: Two teams, one rope, one mud pit, and a very confused bear. Pull on the beat or go for a swim.

theme.keyArtPrompt: Two teams of cartoon kids heaving a giant striped rope over a bubbling mud pit while a puzzled bear sits on the middle of it, one kid mid-splash, silly and dramatic, no text

sprites.player: cartoon kid pulling hard, side view
sprites.rope: giant striped rope with a bear sitting on it, side view

timeline.hostLine: The bear SNEEZED! The rope lurches! Grab on!
Sudden death! The beat speeds up and every pull counts double!

host.intro: Two teams. One rope. One mud pit. Tap PULL on the beat to heave hardest. Losers get muddy!
host.finale: Final ten! Double points! Pull like your socks depend on it!
host.tutorial: Tap PULL. Taps on the beat pull extra hard. Everyone on the beat four times in a row = SURGE! Drag the bear over your line.
